seo.metaTitle: PDF to Word converter — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Convert PDF document pages and paragraphs into an editable Word-compatible document locally in your browser using pdf.js text extraction and RTF/DOCX structuring. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/pdf/pdf-to-word-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: PDF to Word converter processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/pdf/pdf-to-word-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.question: Does PDF to Word converter upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.answer: No. PDF to Word converter executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/pdf/pdf-to-word-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.
faqs.q: Does PDF to Word converter upload my files or text to a server?

faqs.question: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate PDF to Word converter?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/pdf_to_word.json or open /tools/pdf-to-word?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
